text: step 1: ONE finger: move the cursor around
step 3: PRESS the pad: LEFT click 3 times
step 5: PRESS bottom-right corner: RIGHT click 3 times
step 6: TWO fingers: scroll UP and DOWN
step 7: TWO fingers: scroll LEFT and RIGHT
step 8: TWO fingers: PINCH in and out
step 10: THREE fingers: swipe LEFT, 3 times
step 11: THREE fingers: swipe RIGHT, 3 times
step 12: THREE fingers: swipe UP, 3 times
step 13: THREE fingers: swipe DOWN, 3 times
step 14: THREE fingers: swipe LEFT very SLOWLY, once
step 15: THREE fingers: FLICK right fast, 3 times
step 18: FOUR fingers: drag LEFT, 3 times
step 19: FOUR fingers: drag RIGHT, 3 times
step 20: FOUR fingers: drag UP, 3 times
step 21: FOUR fingers: drag DOWN, 3 times
step 22: FOUR fingers: drag in a CIRCLE, then lift
step 23: FOUR fingers: drag, then lift ONE finger at a time
step 24: FIVE fingers: tap and swipe
